name: prophet
description: a Prophet (Fall from Heaven), an elderly holy man: grey hair and a long grey beard, a white robe with wide sleeves and blue trim under a bright blue hooded cloak, a gold medallion on his chest, a brown belt with a brown leather pouch, brown shoes, and a glowing open golden book held in his LEFT hand; he carries no weapon and strikes with his bare RIGHT fist
hands: the open golden book stays in his left hand on the screen-right side, held up in front of his chest; at rest his right hand on the screen-left side supports the book, and during the action it lets go and is the empty fist he strikes with

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, his empty right fist is raised beside the head, the open golden book held in his left hand
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the right fist drawn back behind the head to the left, the open golden book tucked across the belly in his left hand
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the right arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the bare fist punches out level, pointing to the right
strike.4: contact: right arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the bare right fist hammering down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the left arm swung back behind the shoulders for balance, the golden book still in the left hand
strike.5: follow-through: the right fist carries on down toward the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, the grey beard and blue cloak trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the right fist comes back up on the near side toward the book, the open golden book held across the belly

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (his empty right fist thrown up and out to the left, the open golden book flung out to the right in his left hand)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the empty right fist dipping, the golden book still held out in the left hand

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, the empty right arm flung up, the golden book drooping in the left hand
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, the grey-bearded head droops, the empty right fist lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the right knuckles resting on the ground at the lower-right, the left arm holding the golden book hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the golden book slips out of the left hand, legs slide forward, the blue cloak flaring
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the golden book lies open on the ground at the lower-right; the blue cloak spread under him
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the blue cloak settles
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, the open golden book on the ground beside him, its glow faded
